HLEGLAS.NS.d: HLE Glascoat Limited designs and manufactures carbon steel glass lined equipment in India and internationally. It offers reactors, receivers, storage tanks, columns, agitators, valves, pipes and fittings, and other similar equipment and related spares and accessories. The company also provides other engineering equipment, such as agitated filters and dryers, rotary vacuum paddle dryers, other chemical process equipment, and related spares and accessories.

ISHANCH.NS.d: Ishan Dyes and Chemicals Ltd. makes, trades, imports and exports chemicals for the dye and pigment industries in India. Its products include copper phthalocyanine crude blue, solvent dyes and alpha and beta pigment blues, which go into paints, textiles, inks, plastics and rubber. It began in 1993 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad.

JHS.NS.d: JHS Svendgaard Laboratories Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells a range of oral and dental products for adults and kids in India. The company offers oral care products, such as toothbrushes, toothpastes, mouthwash products, hand sanitizers, laundry detergents, room fresheners, and denture products under the Dr. Gold and Aquawhite brands.

KARAMTARA.NS.d: Karamtara Engineering Limited makes and sells solar mounting structures and tracker components, along with transmission products, in India, the Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa and Australia. Its range includes module mounting structures, tracker piles, torque tubes, lattice towers, wind towers, fasteners, and overhead transmission line hardware and substation fittings.

KHAICHEM.NS.d: Khaitan Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited is an Indian company that manufactures and markets fertilizers, chemicals, and specialty products. The company's product portfolio includes single super phosphate (SSP) fertilizer, sulphuric acid, and other related products. Khaitan Chemicals and Fertilizers is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

KIMS.NS.d: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited operates hospitals across India under the KIMS Hospitals brand, providing a broad range of medical services. Its specialties include cardiology, dentistry, neurology, oncology, orthopaedics, nephrology, reproductive medicine, robotic surgery, gastroenterology and heart and lung transplantation.

KITEX.NS.d: Kitex Garments Limited manufactures and sells fabric and readymade garments in India. It primarily offers infant wear comprising body suits, rompters, bibs, burps, sleepwear, and training pants. The company also exports its products to the United States and Europe. Kitex Garments Limited was founded in 1992 and is based in Kochi, India.

KMEW.NS.d: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltd., established in Mumbai in 2015, owns, manages and leases marine vessels in India. It has three divisions covering dredging and port support craft, building and maintaining marine vessels, and developing marine infrastructure, and it also does repair and refitting work.

KRBL.NS.d: KRBL Limited produces and sells rice in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Agri and Energy. The Agri segment offers agricultural commodities, such as rice, furfural, seed, bran, bran oil, etc. The Energy segment generates power from wind turbine, and husk based and solar power plants. This segment has a total wind power project capacity of 112.25 megawatts, solar power project capacity of 15.00 megawatts, and biomass project capacity of 17.59 megawatts.

KTKBANK.NS.d: The Karnataka Bank Limited provides personal and business banking products and services in India. It operates through four segments: Treasury Operations, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations. The company offers savings and current accounts; fixed, cash certificate, and recurring deposits; and non-resident rupee, ordinary non-resident, foreign currency, and resident foreign currency accounts, as well as NRI priority banking services.

LATENTVIEW.NS.d: Latent View Analytics Limited provides business intelligence, consulting, data engineering and digital solutions to clients in India, the United States, the UK and the Netherlands. Chennai is its headquarters, and it dates from 2006. Its analytics work covers marketing and sales optimization, customer insights, risk and compliance, supply chain efficiency, AI and machine learning, and big data.

LATTEYS.NS.d: Latteys Industries Limited, founded in 2004 and based in Ahmedabad, designs, makes and distributes pumps in India for domestic, agricultural, industrial and horticultural use. Its range includes solar, regenerative, shallow well, centrifugal monoblock, self-priming and submersible pumps.

LGEINDIA.NS.d: LG Electronics India Ltd. makes and sells home appliances and consumer electronics through two segments: Home Appliances and Air Solution, and Home Entertainment. The first covers air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines and water purifiers, among others, while the second includes televisions, monitors and personal computers. Founded on January 20, 1997, it is headquartered in Noida.

MANAKALUCO.NS.d: Manaksia Aluminium Company Limited manufactures and sells aluminum products primarily in India. The company offers aluminum sheets and coils, aluminum flooring sheets, aluminum pattern sheets, aluminum roofing sheets, aluminum closure coils and sheets, aluminum color coated coils, aluminum color coated roofing or building sheets, and aluminum alloy ingots. It exports its products to approximately 20 countries in Europe, North America, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and other continents.

MAYURUNIQ.NS.d: Mayur Uniquoters Limited manufactures and sells coated textile fabrics in India and internationally. The company's products include artificial leather/foam leather and other substitutes of leather. Its products are used in footwear, furnishings, automotive OEM, automotive replacement, and automotive exports markets. Mayur Uniquoters Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Jaipur, India.

MERCANTILE.NS.d: Mercantile Ventures Limited is engaged in investments and trading activities in India. The company's activities include investing in shares, stocks, and other securities, as well as trading in commodities and financial instruments. The company is based in Mumbai, India.

MMTC.NS.d: MMTC Limited operates as a trading company in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and North America. It exports mineral products, such as iron ore fines and lumps, chrome ore, chrome concentrate, manganese ore, bentonite, bentonite power, bauxite, feldspar, quartz, sandstone, granite, mica flakes, and other products.

MOTHERSON.NS.d: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited, founded in 1986 and headquartered in Noida, is a diversified global manufacturer supplying components to OEMs, mainly in automotive. Its products include interior and exterior mirrors, camera-based detection systems, polymer modules, precision tools and machined parts, exterior lighting, electronics, HVAC units and compressors, and suspension components.

MVELECTRO.NS.d: MV Electrosystems Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MVELECTRO and traded in INR. Its country is India.

NAHARINDUS.NS.d: Nahar Industrial Enterprises Limited, an integrated textile manufacturer, engages in spinning, weaving, processing, and selling textiles in India. It operates in two segments, Textile and Sugar. The company offers cotton, dyed cotton, compact spun, blended, polyester, industrial, open end, open end slub, TFO, specialized, Eli twist, core spun, and vortex yarns.

NAUKRI-BL.NS.d: Info Edge (India) Limited operates online classifieds businesses. The company's platforms include Naukri.com, Jeevansathi.com, 99acres.com and Shiksha.com. Info Edge is based in India.

NIITLTD.NS.d: NIIT Limited provides training and development solutions to individuals, corporations, and institutions worldwide. The company offers managed training services, such as custom curriculum design and content development, learning administration and technology, learning delivery, strategic sourcing, and advisory services; and learning and talent development programs in banking, finance and insurance, retail sales enablement, management education, multi-sectoral vocational skills, digital media marketing, and programs…

PANACHE.NS.d: Panache Digilife Limited manufactures, distributes, sells, and services information, communication and technology, and internet of thing devices in India and internationally. The company provides smart compute devices, such as squair, clair, flair AIO, air, desair, and desktop PCs, as well as laptops and NUCs; and POS terminals, thermal printers, cash drawers, and touch monitors, as well as consumer light-emitting diode televisions, commercial signage displays, and AV solutions.

PBMPOLY.NS.d: PBM Polytex Limited is an Indian textile company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of polyester yarn and fabrics. They cater to various industries, including apparel, home textiles, and industrial applications. The company is based in India.

PDSL.NS.d: PDS Limited and its subsidiaries operate across the value chain of ready-to-wear clothing and consumer goods, from design and sourcing to manufacturing, marketing and distribution. It has sourcing, manufacturing and venture investment segments, and its range includes clothing for adults, kids and infants, licensed apparel, footwear and accessories.

PERNIASPOP.NS.d: Purple Style Labs Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker PERNIASPOP and traded in INR. Its country is India.

QMSMEDI.NS.d: QMS Medical Allied Services Ltd. markets, distributes and manufactures medical products and provides healthcare services in India. It distributes devices made by others as well as its own Q Devices line, which includes glucometers, pulse oximeters, IR thermometers and blood pressure monitors.

RBLBANK.NS.d: RBL Bank Limited operates as a scheduled commercial bank in India. It operates through Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, Treasury, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company's deposit products include savings accounts, current accounts, institution accounts, and fixed deposits.

SANOFI.NS.d: Sanofi India Limited manufactures and trades in drugs and pharmaceutical products in India, Singapore and internationally. The company provides pharmaceutical products in various therapeutic areas, such as diabetes, cardiology, thrombosis, infections, epilepsy, anti-infectives, and central nervous system, as well as allergy, pain care, digestive, and nutritional health under the Lantus, Toujeo, Soliqua, Clexane, Amaryl, Cardace, Lasix, Lasilactone, Glimepiride, Cetapin, Targocid, Frisium, Targocio, Combiflam,…

SGLRES.NS.d: SGL Resources Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SGLRES and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SINCLAIR.NS.d: Sinclairs Hotels Limited runs hotels and resorts in India's hospitality sector. Its properties are found in West Bengal at Siliguri, Darjeeling, Dooars, Kalimpong and Burdwan, in Ooty, in Sikkim at Gangtok and Yangang, and in Port Blair. The company was founded in 1971 and has its main office in Kolkata.

SPTL.NS.d: Sintex Plastics Technology Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic products in India, the United States, and Europe. The company operates in two segments, Custom Moulding Business; and Infra, Prefab & Other Business.

SRTRANSFIN-ZF.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 8.75% Sr.III represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 8.75% and belonging to Series III of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

SWARAJENG.NS.d: Swaraj Engines Limited manufactures and sells diesel engines, diesel engine components, and spare parts for tractors in India. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mohali, India.

TATATECH.NS.d: Tata Technologies Limited provides product engineering and digital services in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific, in Service and Technology Solutions segments. Its offerings include consultancy on engineering and design using CAD/CAM, IT consultancy, networking, implementation and maintenance of SAP, education services and resale of third-party software.

TBZ.NS.d: Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited designs, manufactures, retails, and sells jewellery primarily in India. The company offers gold, diamond studded, precious and semi-precious stone studded, and plain and diamond studded platinum jewellery; jewellery with colored stones in gold and diamond; loose diamond solitaires; loose precious and semi-precious stones; and jadau jewellery. As of March 31, 2020, it operated thirty six owned stores and three franchise stores in twenty seven cities.

THEINVEST.NS.d: The Investment Trust of India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides corporate finance and broking solutions in India. It operates through Advisory Services and Investment Activities; and Trading Activities segments.

VEDPOWER.NS.d: Vedanta Power Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VEDPOWER and traded in INR. It is classified in the Utilities sector. Its country is India.

VIJIFIN.NS.d: Viji Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides financial products and services in India. It offers corporate finance, infrastructure/project finance, and personal finance. The company was formerly known as Panjon Finance Limited and changed its name to Viji Finance Limited in September 2012. Viji Finance Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Indore, India.

VPRPL.NS.d: VPRPL, formally Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited, is an Indian firm providing engineering, procurement and construction services. It designs and builds water supply and sewerage networks, rail, road and bridge projects, irrigation systems and tunnels, and operates and maintains them afterward. Its customers range from national, state and local governments to public sector undertakings.

WHIRLPOOL.NS.d: Whirlpool of India Limited manufactures and trades in home appliances under the Whirlpool brand in India and internationally. The company primarily offers refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, microwave ovens, and small appliances, as well as air and water purifiers. It also provides built-in appliances, including built-in ovens, coffee machines, microwave ovens, cooker hoods, hobs, dishwashers, wine coolers, and washers and dryers, as well as commercial appliances and accessories.

WIPL.NS.d: The Western India Plywoods Limited manufactures and sells plywood, hard boards, densified wood, and other wood products in India. The company offers fire retardant and resin surfaced shuttering plywood for applications in industrial filters, and paneling and ceiling substrates in hotels, hospitals, theatres, etc.; marine plywood for boat building, and load and stress bearing industrial applications; and boiling water resistant plywood for use in furniture, structural work in interior design, auto motive coach…

ZOTA.NS.d: Zota Health Care Limited manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products in India. The company offers generic drugs, OTC pharmaceutical products, ayurvedic products, and nutraceutical products. As of December 30, 2020, it operated 491 retail stores under the DAVAINDIA name in 21 states of India. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Surat, India.
